children: Citrea plans to activate the Pomelo fork on its layer-2 mainnet by 26 Nov 2026. The network is expected to keep running without disruption during the activation.
The fork completes Citrea's mainnet upgrade with SP1 already in place to power the network's proofs. Citrea has not announced any changes to the economics of the CTR token as part of the upgrade.
Citrea's proving system is now running on
The full Pomelo activation will follow in the next 3 days with no mainnet disruptions expected.
